args.title: Use configured base URL instead of localhost in password reset emails
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use config.baseUrl instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL (which falls back to localhost) when building the password reset email link, so emails generated in production point to the configured domain rather than localhost.
